megan.cs: Heads-up — Voyager onboarding (acct VGR-9) is seeing a spike of preflight failures during SDK init: mix of 401s and 429s. Passing to eng to triage.

 tom.eng: Which SDK and version?

 megan.cs: Node SDK v1.2.3 via sdkgateway. Customer does parallel warmup workers. Sample from their logs:

 ```text
 2025-03-02T15:12:03Z INFO preflight start worker=3
 2025-03-02T15:12:03Z WARN preflight 401 /auth/start key=redacted
 2025-03-02T15:12:04Z ERROR preflight 429 rate_limit preflight endpoint
 ```

 luis.support: Noticed retries in telemetry — they spawn 8 workers that all preflight at once. If tokens rotate fast it creates a thundering herd.

 megan.cs: They mentioned ephemeral tokens TTL ~10s. Combine that with 8 workers and a key rotation window and you get many failed preflights.

 tom.eng: Mitigations: recommend client-side splay + single-flight token fetch. On infra side we can temporary relax preflight quota for VGR-9 while they patch. Can ops open a temporary rate bump?

 deploy-bot: Created support ticket INC-8721 — requested temporary quota bump for VGR-9. ETA ~30m.

 megan.cs: I'll confirm with customer, but we should also give them a one-line snippet to debounce preflight.

 tom.eng: Snippet suggestion (single-flight pattern):

 ```js
 let tokenPromise = null;
 async function getEphemeralToken(){
   if (!tokenPromise) tokenPromise = fetch('/auth/ephemeral').finally(()=> tokenPromise = null);
   return tokenPromise;
 }
 ```

 Add jitter + capped exponential backoff for retries.

 luis.support: I'll tail the edge-proxy logs to verify 429 burst windows and report back.

 tom.eng: Telemetry shows preflight endpoints are counted per session. 8 workers => 8x the load. Ops: can we bump VGR-9 ephemeral token grace to 60s temporarily? @megan.cs confirm customer ok.

 megan.cs: Customer agreed to bump TTL to 60s and will deploy client change too. I'll send recommended snippet + timeline.

 luis.support: Tail shows ~600 preflight requests in a 3s window from the same IP. Applying temporary rate relax now and will monitor.

 deploy-bot: Applied temporary quota change for VGR-9. ChangeID Q-9876. Monitor window 2h.

 megan.cs: After the TTL bump + client debounce the error rate dropped from ~25% to ~1.2%. Customer happy. Please add a note to onboarding checklist.

 tom.eng: I'll open a docs PR to add 'debounce preflight' guidance and sample code. Tagging @luis.support for TTL recommendation.

 luis.support: Will review the PR. Also proposing a telemetry alert for accounts exceeding 200 preflights/min to catch this earlier.

 megan.cs: Great. Closing once PR merged. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 

 deploy-bot: Thread marked resolved by megan.cs
